name: Alaska Food Equipment
old_description: Alaska Food Equipment was established 30+ years ago to help Alaskans with their commercial food equipment needs. From the larger retailers to small restaurants & food carts, Alaska Food Equipment has been supplying and servicing all makes & models of equipment throughout Alaska.
about:
Alaska Food Equipment operates from Anchorage, Alaska, where it was founded over 30 years ago to address the commercial food equipment needs of businesses across the state. The company does not disclose its founders or ownership structure in the available materials.

The firm supplies and services all makes and models of commercial food equipment, offering emergency repair service 24 hours a day. It also provides delivery, installation, and ongoing maintenance throughout Alaska, leveraging a network of supplier partnerships to mitigate supply chain delays. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

Customers range from large retailers to small restaurants and food carts, essentially any food service operation in Alaska that requires equipment procurement or repair.

The company emphasizes customer service and attention to detail, stating it stands behind its service 100 percent and operates on the principle that if a product is not in stock, it can be sourced.
